name: Repeat
description: Renders its single child component once per item in dataBinding. Real apps map this to SwiftUI ForEach or React .map(); the previewer iterates the fixture entries for that binding. Use this anywhere a screen contains a dynamic list of identical rows.

dataBinding.description: A list binding registered in actions.json (e.g. 'tasks.active').

emptyTextKey.description: If set, shown when the list is empty instead of the children.
